company.name: Gate terminal
company.description:
Gate terminal on Maasvlakte in Rotterdam is the first and only LNG import terminal in the Netherlands. The terminal, a joint venture between Nederlandse Gasunie and Royal Vopak, supports the supply and throughput of LNG (liquefied natural gas) for Northwest Europe. 

LNG arrives by carrier from areas including the Middle East, Norway and Africa. Storage tanks enable large quantities of LNG to be unloaded in one go. The terminal operates as a hub in which the product is reloaded in smaller carriers for export, or is converted into natural gas and transported via pipelines to the European distribution network. Gate terminal has facilities for loading LNG in vessels, containers and trucks. LNG can then be transported to supply natural gas in areas without a pipeline infrastructure or can supply at petrol stations. 

This first Dutch LNG import terminal has been operational since 2011 and has an annual throughput capacity of 12 billion m3 of gas per year. The Gate terminal capacity covers approximately a third of the national gas consumption. The terminal has three storage tanks, three jetties, three loading sites for lorries and an area in which LNG is converted into natural gas.
company.description_ai: Gate terminal operates the first and only LNG import terminal in the Netherlands, located on the Maasvlakte in Rotterdam. It receives LNG from around the world, stores it, regasifies it for delivery to the gas grid, and reloads LNG into ships, containers and trucks for trade and fuel use.

When it comes to logistics we never say no. We have a solution at hand, and if not, create one. With our know-how and attitude to set about and getting things done, we make sure you don’t need to worry about your cargo. We do that for you. We care about cargo.
 
Full-service solutions
TMA Logistics offers you full-service solutions for land, sea and air transport, stevedoring, cargo transhipment, project cargoes, storage, customs handling, value added services and more. All 24/7 and worldwide.

Most services are provided by the joint effort of our working companies: Thor Shipping & Transport (TST), MEO and ACS. It’s the combined strength of those companies that counts, because by working together anything is possible and we never have to say no. So if it's 'Yes!' you want for an answer, feel free to contact us.
 
Discover our expertise:

• Stevedoring

• Intermodal 
• Agencies
• Shipping

company.description_seo: TMA Logistics is met 4 multi-purpose terminals de flexibele logistieke draaischijf in Noord-Nederland. Bekijk onze website voor meer info.
company.description_ai: TMA Logistics is a Dutch logistics provider with multi-purpose terminals and over 100,000 m² of warehousing in the North Sea Canal area, North Netherlands and Antwerp. It offers port logistics, forwarding, intermodal barge services, customs agency and value added warehousing for containers, bulk, breakbulk, project cargo and RoRo.
company.industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

company.name: JR Shipping
company.description: JR Shipping is an experienced and renowned ship owning company, leading in the market of container feeder vessels. The shipping group owns and operates a fast growing fleet of modern container feeder vessels sailing under the Dutch quality flag. The container vessels are successfully chartered out to first class container line operators by the group’s own charter broker company. The decisive ship management organisation, as well as the dedicated staff on board of the vessels, stimulate the excellent performance of the JR Shipping fleet. Today, nearly 250 people are employed on board and on shore.
company.description_seo: Your dedicated short sea shipping partner, specialized in the operation & management of container feeder, multipurpose and offshore service vessels.
company.description_ai: JR Shipping Group is a Harlingen-based short sea shipping company founded in 1993. It operates and manages container feeder, short sea dry cargo, offshore service vessels and Tall Ships. The group provides all-round ship management, chartering, brokerage, offshore services and ship investment projects, with strong focus on quality, safety and sustainability.
